name: Summary Human Priority Plan
description: Prioritize future judgment queue top-ups toward articles with answered human summaries for summary-mode projects while preserving prompt-mode behavior, scan cursor semantics, and existing SQLite ready ordering.

userStories.title: Load mode-aware job config and summary priority candidates
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want `judgmentsJobsAddToQueue` to load `humanJudgmentMode` and resolve answered summary-backed article IDs so queue top-ups can distinguish prompt-mode pair priority from summary-mode article priority without breaking legacy prompt defaults.
acceptanceCriteria: Extend the add-to-queue job config lookup to include `humanJudgmentMode` alongside the existing model and content settings.
Treat `NULL` `humanJudgmentMode` values as `prompt` so legacy or unset projects keep the current prompt-mode behavior.
Add a summary-mode helper in `judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.ts` that batches fetched, post-filter prompt entries by `article_id` and queries `app.judgment_human_summary` for the current `project_id`.
The summary-mode helper treats only non-empty answers as priority candidates using `NULLIF(TRIM(COALESCE(answer, '')), '') IS NOT NULL`.
The helper returns matching article IDs so every fetched prompt row for those articles can be prioritized within the current fetched window.
Prompt-mode pair-based answered-human lookup remains available for non-summary projects.
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsSendToLLM/getAndUpdateReadyPrompts.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes

userStories.title: Apply stable summary-mode prioritization before SQLite insertion
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want summary-mode queue top-ups to reorder only the fetched candidate window before insertion so summary-backed articles claim first without changing OLAP ordering, existing ready rows, or scan cursor behavior.
acceptanceCriteria: After `filterAlreadyJudged` and local SQLite judged filtering, the top-up flow branches on `humanJudgmentMode ?? 'prompt'` before choosing a priority strategy.
Prompt mode keeps the current stable partition of fetched rows by answered `(articleId, promptId)` pair.
Summary mode stable-partitions fetched rows into `summaryHumanFirst` and `rest` by article ID while preserving original order within both groups.
The reordered rows are passed into `addReadyPrompts` so SQLite ready claim order for newly inserted rows reflects the priority choice.
Prioritization remains subject to the existing `readyDeficit` cap and does not change OLAP candidate ordering, scan cursor semantics, or the order of rows already queued in local SQLite `ready`.
Already-judged and locally judged rows still do not enter the queue even if their article has an answered human summary.
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsAddToQueue.test.ts` passes
`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsSendToLLM/getAndUpdateReadyPrompts.test.ts` passes
`bun run lint` passes

userStories.title: Cover summary-mode prioritization edge cases in add-to-queue tests
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want focused regression coverage for summary-mode add-to-queue prioritization so future changes cannot break article-level promotion, filtering, or project isolation.
acceptanceCriteria: Add coverage proving all fetched prompt rows for an article with an answered human summary move to the front of the fetched candidate list, not just one prompt.
Add coverage proving `NULL` or blank summary answers do not get priority.
Add coverage proving summary rows from another project do not affect prioritization.
Add coverage proving already-judged and locally judged rows are still filtered out even when the article has an answered human summary.
Add coverage proving multiple summary-backed articles preserve their original relative order and prompt-mode tests continue to pass unchanged.

`bun test src/server/cron/judgmentsJobs/judgmentsJobsSendToLLM/getAndUpdateReadyPrompts.test.ts` passes

userStories.title: Prove summary-backed rows claim first in actual SQLite order
userStories.description: As a maintainer, I want an end-to-end top-up regression test that exercises SQLite insertion and claiming so summary-backed rows visibly claim first when they appear later in the fetched window.
acceptanceCriteria: Add a top-up regression test proving an article with an answered human summary appearing later in the fetched window is claimed first when `readyDeficit` is smaller than the window.
The regression covers actual `judgmentsJobsAddToQueue -> addReadyPrompts -> claimReadyPrompts` behavior rather than only asserting an intermediate reordered array.
Existing ready-row semantics remain intact: the new test does not require reshuffling rows already queued in local SQLite `ready`.
